Generate a gournal work log grouped by day (today by default, or yesterday/week/month, or a from/to range). Optionally filter by project, repo, and tags.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `yesterday` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `week` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `month` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `from` | `string` | no | Start date (inclusive): a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp |
| `to` | `string` | no | End date (inclusive): a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp |
| `project` | `string` | no | Filter by project name |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Filter by repository (owner/name) |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Filter to entries containing all of these tags |
